LrObZ_HZZUc.title: London Swallowed a City but Couldn't Digest It.
LrObZ_HZZUc.summary: CGP Grey explains that the City of London is a tiny, separate entity with its own governance, history and privileges, distinct from the city called London. He covers its financial role and how it is run.
LrObZ_HZZUc.why: HN's go-to short explainer for the City of London versus London, cited in many finance and UK threads.

quote.text: CGP Grey has a delightful video explaining this

GNO_CYUjMK8.title: [JSConfUS 2013] Steven Wittens: Making WebGL Dance
GNO_CYUjMK8.summary: Steven Wittens' JSConf US 2013 talk on drawing with WebGL, using animated visuals to walk through vectors, matrices and the rendering pipeline. Despite the title, it works as a visual primer on the linear algebra behind 3D graphics.
GNO_CYUjMK8.why: HN treats it as one of the best intros to the math of 3D graphics and a staple answer to how to learn graphics programming.

quote.text: It's a fantastic, FANTASTIC tour of 3D graphics fundamentals.

3ka4KY7TMTU.title: Self and Self: Whys and Wherefores
3ka4KY7TMTU.summary: David Ungar of IBM Research reflects at Stanford on the Self language project and argues the real legacy of ideas is the people. He covers its history, philosophy, successes and failures.
3ka4KY7TMTU.why: HN points to it as the best account of what Self made possible and what its team went on to do.

quote.text: explains the history, philosophy, successes, and failures of the Self project

L_XJ_s5IsQc.title: Snarky Puppy - Lingus (We Like It Here)
L_XJ_s5IsQc.summary: A live, overdub-free performance of 'Lingus' by Snarky Puppy, from the 'We Like It Here' DVD recorded in Utrecht. It features a Cory Henry keyboard solo.
L_XJ_s5IsQc.why: HN commenters recommend Snarky Puppy as proof that vibrant, progressive modern jazz is being made today.

quote.text: I highly recommend anything by Snarky Puppy.

1Hqm0dYKUx4.title: Why It's Impossible to Tune a Piano
1Hqm0dYKUx4.summary: A minutephysics video explaining why a piano cannot be perfectly tuned, comparing equal temperament with just intonation and the math of harmonics.
1Hqm0dYKUx4.why: Commenters link it as a quick, clear explanation of why twelve notes only approximate simple ratios.

quote.text: minutephysics had a nice video about the mathematics that go behind piano tuning too.

9QWaZp_2I1k.title: How did consciousness evolve? - with Nicholas Humphrey
9QWaZp_2I1k.summary: A Royal Institution lecture in which Nicholas Humphrey presents his theory of phenomenal consciousness and its evolution. He draws on the book Sentience and discusses evidence for animal sentience.
9QWaZp_2I1k.why: Recommended as a good high-level view of Humphrey's book and his argument on how consciousness evolved.

quote.text: His recent RI lecture was great and a good high level view of the book.

aP0Y1uAA-2Y.title: Stanford Seminar: Beyond Floating Point: Next Generation Computer Arithmetic
aP0Y1uAA-2Y.summary: John Gustafson presents posits, a proposed drop-in replacement for IEEE 754 floats that is simpler in hardware and more flexible in precision. The seminar includes a live demo and machine learning results.
aP0Y1uAA-2Y.why: Cited in floating-point threads as the main introduction to posits and unums as an alternative to IEEE floats.

jhicDUgXyNg.title: Delvon Lamarr Organ Trio - Warm-up Set (Live on KEXP)
jhicDUgXyNg.summary: A live KEXP warm-up set by the Delvon Lamarr Organ Trio, recorded at Upstream Music Fest in 2017. The set includes Move On Up and Memphis.
jhicDUgXyNg.why: HN people recommend it as a great live KEXP session with standout guitar work and good sound.

quote.text: He's hands down one of the most talented guitarists alive today.

ooOL4T-BAg0.title: Rhyme: Why Eminem is one of the most impressive lyricists ever
ooOL4T-BAg0.summary: A re-upload of a video breaking down Eminem's rhyme schemes, showing multi-syllable and internal rhymes in songs such as Lose Yourself. It aims to show why he is considered a standout lyricist.
ooOL4T-BAg0.why: Recommended in threads on rap vocabulary and rhyme generation as a clear visual explanation of Eminem's rhyming technique.

quote.text: this absolute standout of a YouTube video about the rhyme scheme in Eminem's Lose Yourself.

MmG2ah5Df4g.title: Quantum Field Theory visualized
MmG2ah5Df4g.summary: ScienceClic gives a 15-minute animated introduction to quantum field theory, covering fields, spin, conserved quantities, the standard model and interactions.
MmG2ah5Df4g.why: Offered as an accessible visualization for people wanting to understand particles as excitations of fields.

quote.text: I mean there are ways to visualize these things

dlbMuv-jix8.title: Lecture 1B | MIT 6.001 Structure and Interpretation, 1986
dlbMuv-jix8.summary: Lecture 1B of MIT's 6.001 Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs (1986) with Gerald Sussman, covering procedures, processes and the substitution model. It includes the line about the power of naming things.
dlbMuv-jix8.why: HN commenters hold it up as an unmatched introduction to programming and quote Sussman's line that knowing a spirit's name gives you power over it.

quote.text: I don't think it's possible to do any better than this

rqOUgqsWvbw.title: Your web app but good: Aaron Boodman (Local-First Conf)
rqOUgqsWvbw.summary: Aaron Boodman of Replicache asks why sync engines have not yet fixed web app complexity and what is missing for them to go mainstream. The talk lays out the ideas that led to the Zero sync engine.
rqOUgqsWvbw.why: Cited in sync-engine threads as the origin story for Zero and for hybrid local and remote queries.

quote.text: wholeheartedly recommend this wonderful talk about the thoughts that led to this

LEENEFaVUzU.title: The Last Human – A Glimpse Into The Far Future
LEENEFaVUzU.summary: A Kurzgesagt animation on longtermism, arguing that because the future could hold trillions of people, our actions' effect on future generations may be what matters most.
LEENEFaVUzU.why: HN uses it as a reference for the scale of future human population and long-term thinking.

quote.text: Kurzgesagt has some interesting videos on human population

VJ-p9qOhBv4.title: Cats in a Cat Cafe in Japan Reacting to an Earthquake - 994393
VJ-p9qOhBv4.summary: A one-minute clip from a cat cafe in Japan where sleeping cats wake and look around just before an earthquake begins shaking the room.
VJ-p9qOhBv4.why: Commenters use it in earthquake threads as an anecdote that animals may sense tremors seconds before humans, and occasionally as a joke about cat alarms.

quote.text: you can clearly see the cats get alerted to something ~10 seconds before the shaking starts

sR8M4zARBXY.title: Synthesizing Chicken Noodle Soup From Pure Chemicals
sR8M4zARBXY.summary: The Thought Emporium synthesizes chicken noodle soup from pure chemicals, following an original patent for artificial chicken flavor. The video explores how many chemicals it takes to make a convincing soup.
sR8M4zARBXY.why: Brought up in threads on synthetic food and flavor as a fun example of building a dish from chemicals.

quote.text: There's a great recent Thought Emporium video where he synthesizes chicken noodle soup from pure chemicals

03iwAY4KlIU.title: Appalachian English
03iwAY4KlIU.summary: An excerpt from the documentary Mountain Talk on Appalachian English. Residents of Southern Appalachia talk about their dialect and give examples of its distinctive words.
03iwAY4KlIU.why: Cited as an example of a distinctive local dialect, with unfamiliar words and phrases.

quote.text: the vid gives examples of words I've never heard

1_FXVjf46T8.title: SpaceX Pad Abort Test
1_FXVjf46T8.summary: A short SpaceX video of the Dragon 2 pad abort test, in which the capsule's thrusters fire to carry it away from the launch pad. It also shows the pad deluge system.
1_FXVjf46T8.why: HN commenters cite it as evidence that Dragon's built-in launch escape system works and that a failed launch need not kill the crew.

quote.text: SpaceX demo'ed their launch abort system

AEtbFm_CjE0.title: Delta P
AEtbFm_CjE0.summary: A short video illustrating the hazard of pressure differentials (delta P) in commercial diving, where a pressure difference creates enormous force on a diver. It is a safety-oriented look at diving accidents.
AEtbFm_CjE0.why: Shared as nightmare fuel in threads on diving and underwater work to show how deadly pressure differentials are.

quote.text: Pressure differentials are a constant threat in commercial diving operations.

QtgVxGkrX1Y.title: Trump Suggests Injecting Disinfectant Into The Body To Treat Coronavirus | MSNBC
QtgVxGkrX1Y.summary: MSNBC's clip of the April 2020 White House coronavirus briefing in which President Trump responds to a DHS presentation on disinfectants by musing about injecting disinfectant into the body. The segment is three minutes long.
QtgVxGkrX1Y.why: Used as primary footage when commenters need to check exactly what was said, in threads on COVID misinformation and trusting authorities.

quote.text: You can literally watch him come up with the idea all on his own in real time.

aNi17YLnZpg.title: Insane Volvo brake test epic fail
aNi17YLnZpg.summary: A short clip of a Volvo C60 automatic braking demonstration in which the car fails to stop. It was widely circulated as a press-demo embarrassment.
aNi17YLnZpg.why: Cited as a cautionary example whenever collision-avoidance or self-driving safety systems come up.

kO5EXjFKE7U.title: ✖️Coronavirus TIMELINE
kO5EXjFKE7U.summary: A data-visualization style timeline of the early coronavirus outbreak events by YouTuber Nathan Rich. It lays out dates of key developments in China.
kO5EXjFKE7U.why: Used as a reference timeline in arguments over whether information was suppressed, with commenters noting a possible pro-China bias.
